financing.summary: Green Brick is a land-heavy, self-developing builder: at 2026-09-30 it owned 79.5% of 51,435 lots, develops most of them itself in infill and infill-adjacent DFW, Atlanta, Austin and Houston submarkets, and says on every call that it does not use land banking (Co-CEO Jim Brickman calls it high-interest money paid at 8-12% that shifts control of takedown timing to the land banker). It funds land from operating cash flow, a $330M unsecured revolver (Flagstar agent; $105M drawn at Q3 2026), about $188M of low-coupon (3.25-3.35%) privately placed senior notes amortising through 2029, and $50M of 5.75% perpetual preferred; homebuilding debt-to-capital is 13.1% (net 9.6%). The only off-balance-sheet lot control is 7,553 option lots from unnamed third-party sellers plus 3,013 lots through four 50/50 development JVs (two with Taylor Morrison, one with Hersh Family Investments, one Atlanta JV via The Providence Group). Room for a land banker is small by stated policy, but 2026 land spend was cut from $850M to $780M, cash fell to $100M and the revolver was drawn, so watch whether leadership's stance softens under the new Co-CEO (Jed Dolson) structure.
financing.land_strategy: Owns most (company framing: 'owning and self-developing land in desirable infill and infill-adjacent submarkets'). Targets entitled parcels that yield finished lots 12-24 months after purchase, also large multi-phase master plans of 5-10+ years that it says land bankers avoid; buying finished lots from third-party developers is a much smaller share. Explicitly does not use land banking. Target debt-to-capital about 20%. 2026 land budget: about $350M land/lot acquisition plus about $430M development (total $780M, cut from $850M).

lots.note: Optioned = 'lots under contract': 7,553 lots/land under option contracts + 3,013 lots under option through unconsolidated development JVs. Owned split: 5,572 finished, 31,497 in communities under development, 3,800 land held for future development. 28.6% of lots under contract carry refundable deposits. Definition changed from 'lots controlled' to 'lots under contract' at 2025-12-31 (FY2025: 37,023 owned / 11,805 under contract / 48,828 total, 75.8% owned). Years of supply not disclosed by the company; rough own estimate is about 13 years on total lots versus 3,943 homes delivered in 2025.

land_banking.counterparty: Unnamed third-party land sellers and lot developers
land_banking.description: Lot option and purchase-and-sale contracts with staged takedowns and non-refundable deposits paid after land-committee approval; counterparties not named. At 2025-12-31: $14.8M earnest money at risk on contracts for 9,633 lots, aggregate price about $377.6M. Company says it was not the primary beneficiary of any land/lot option VIE.
land_banking.note: Lots (7,553) are at 2026-09-30 per the Q3 2026 earnings release; the $377.6M price and $14.8M deposits are at 2025-12-31 from the 10-K. Not land banking: management states it does not use land bankers.

land_banking.description: Lots optioned to Green Brick builders out of four 50/50 land-development JVs (GBTM Sendera, TMGB Magnolia Ridge, Rainwater Crossing Single-Family, EJB River Holdings). Management says the JVs are 6% of lots owned and under contract and 3% of assets.

Repaid the final $50M of the 4.00% 2026 senior notes at maturity.
Drew $105M on the unsecured revolver during 2026 (from $0 at year-end 2025) while cash fell to $100M; Q3 buyback 264,215 shares for $17.9M with $132.7M authorisation remaining.
